ideas.pitch: An agentic GraphRAG system built on TigerGraph that autonomously traverses complex data dependencies and historical incident logs to diagnose multi-hop pipeline failures and generate verified patch pull requests.
ideas.title: GraphTrace: Autonomous Data Lineage & Incident Root-Cause Agent
ideas.why_it_could_win: Directly mirrors the grand-prize-winning architecture of BlackBox at the DataHub Agent Hackathon by solving a hard data engineering problem with evidence-backed reasoning and write-back capabilities.

ideas.pitch: An autonomous studio executive agent that ingests raw screenplays, extracts character dynamics and plot nodes into TigerGraph, and iteratively queries vector/graph evidence to simulate greenlight feasibility and narrative continuity.
ideas.title: ScriptToGraph: Agentic Cinematic Narrative & Relationship Explores
ideas.why_it_could_win: Leverages the multi-step reasoning required by the TigerGraph Agentic GraphRAG prompt while hitting the exact chord of the CINE-MIND Grand Prize winner at the Agentic Cinema Hackathon.

ideas.pitch: A benchmarking tool that tests TigerGraph Agentic RAG implementations by forcing autonomous multi-hop reasoning agents through a rigorous 3-turn metacognitive evaluation loop to spot hallucination gaps and retrieval failures.
ideas.title: MetaGraph: 3-Turn Metacognitive Evaluator for GraphRAG Agents
ideas.why_it_could_win: Applies the strict benchmarking and metacognition patterns seen in the Google DeepMind x Kaggle GAUGE grand-prize winner, appealing to judges looking for rigorous validation of agentic reliability.

ideas.pitch: A zero-config toolkit that ingests messy enterprise documentation, auto-extracts entities into TigerGraph schemas using TOON-native formatting, and deploys a self-correcting multi-step retrieval agent.
ideas.title: AutoSchema RAG: Native Graph Document Toolkit for TigerGraph
ideas.why_it_could_win: Follows the exact blueprint of the seamless-rag 2nd place winner at the MariaDB Hackathon by providing an essential developer tool and toolkit that makes working with the core sponsor technology seamless.

ideas.pitch: An agentic diagnostic platform that connects real-time telemetry data with historical maintenance manuals stored in TigerGraph, performing recursive multi-step queries to diagnose complex industrial equipment faults.
ideas.title: GraphPulse: Battery & IoT Digital Twin Multi-Step Diagnostic Agent
ideas.why_it_could_win: Combines the hard frontend data visualization of the Frontend Hackathon Next Stop Station winner with deep graph-based multi-hop retrieval to create a live, highly demonstrable industrial product.
